metadata.note: Digestive / metabolic disorder rules. 'avoid_allergens' additionally excludes allergen-listed foods. 'avoid_tags'/'prefer_tags' filter foods.json tags. 'limit_nutrients' caps contribution.
metadata.warning_text: Automated diet guidance is informational and not a substitute for a physician or dietitian.

lactose_intolerance.label: Lactose Intolerance
lactose_intolerance.note: Dairy avoided. Use lactose-free milk, soya milk, or small amounts of curd/ghee if tolerated.

celiac.label: Celiac Disease / Gluten Intolerance
celiac.note: Strictly avoid wheat, barley, rye. Use certified gluten-free millets (ragi, jowar, bajra), rice, quinoa.

ibs.label: Irritable Bowel Syndrome
ibs.note: Low-FODMAP approach: well-cooked dals, easy vegetables; choose fiber gradually.

gerd.label: Acidity / GERD
gerd.note: Avoid spicy, fried and heavy meals late at night; keep meals small and frequent.

diabetes.label: Diabetes / Prediabetes
diabetes.note: Prefer whole millets, pulses, and fiber; limit refined sugar, sugary drinks and refined flour.

ckd.label: Chronic Kidney Disease
ckd.note: Physician-led dietary plan required - potassium, phosphorus and sodium often restricted.

hypertension.label: Hypertension
hypertension.note: Restrict salt and packaged foods; increase potassium-rich vegetables and fruits.

gout.label: Gout / High Uric Acid
gout.note: Limit organ meats, red meat and shellfish; drink water and prefer vegetables and dairy.

pcos.label: PCOS / Hormonal Imbalance
pcos.note: Prefer low-glycemic whole foods and protein; limit refined sugar.
